# Screens (docs/architecture.md section 7): plain LVGL, no ESP-IDF drivers, so the same code runs
# in the Windows version (host/sim). The icon fonts are generated by tools/build_icons.py, the
# logo of the start screen by tools/build_logo.py. test_screen.cpp is only linked when main calls
# it (CONFIG_HC_BOARD_BRING_UP).
idf_component_register(SRCS "src/test_screen.cpp" "src/theme.cpp" "src/settings.cpp" "src/settings_pages.cpp"
                            "src/overlay.cpp" "src/ui.cpp" "src/keyboard.cpp" "src/power.cpp" "src/rotation.cpp" "src/setup.cpp"
                            "src/dashboard.cpp" "src/edit_mode.cpp" "src/icons.cpp" "src/tiles.cpp" "src/panel.cpp" "src/light_panel.cpp" "src/climate_panel.cpp" "src/sensor_panel.cpp" "src/history_view.cpp" "src/lock_panel.cpp" "src/picture_panel.cpp" "src/runner.cpp" "src/splash.cpp" "src/sound.cpp" "src/settings_sound.cpp" "src/alarm.cpp" "src/settings_alarm.cpp"
                            "src/fonts/hc_mdi_24.c" "src/fonts/hc_mdi_48.c"
                       INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
                       REQUIRES core memory)
